headline: Germany's Q3 2026 GDP Revised Down to 0.1% Growth
summary: Germany's gross domestic product grew by 0.1 percent in the third quarter of 2026, revised down slightly from earlier expectations and reflecting slower-than-expected economic momentum.
why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and its macroeconomic performance sets the tone for regional industrial demand and Eurozone growth.

impacts.name: Germany
impacts.why: Slower GDP growth reflects subdued domestic economic activity in Europe's largest economy.
